title: Host Rating Minimums and Per-Class Listing Ceilings
content:
Two figures attach to the host rather than to the vehicle in every Keyturn Vehicle Listing class: the lowest host rating the class allows a listing to be held on, and the number of listings one host may hold in that class.

| Class | Lowest host rating allowed | Listings one host may hold in the class |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 4.0 | 5 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 4.2 | 8 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 4.5 | 10 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 4.7 | 6 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 4.9 | 3 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 4.4 | 25 |

The ceilings do not rise with the class: the Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing carries the largest ceiling of the six at 25 listings, and the Keyturn Exotic Class Listing the smallest at 3, while the rating minimum rises to 4.9 in that same Exotic class. A host rated 4.6 stands above the minimum of the Keyturn Premium Class Listing and below the minimum of the Keyturn Luxury Class Listing.
